description: NOVA RIDE edge v2 NPZ, in the final mode order (nova_edge_v2_modes.json): from Kris's new Edge V1-V4 SPEAR captures (2026-11-27). velw: per mode, the peak amplitude of the partials assigned to their nearest mode within +-0.25 %, ^0.8, normalised per velocity; partials below 90 Hz and at 110-122 Hz (room, stand) left out. Envelopes: the 22 plugin bands, 20 ms frames from the strike, gaps filled, 140 ms median and 60 ms Gaussian after 150 ms, continued at their own slope past the noise floor, then decaying 1/0.85 as fast after 160 ms (ring 15 % shorter, Kris). rms_correction from the velw norms as build_preset.py. pk_t_edge_by_vel: per-mode peak times (no audible effect: NPZ edge strikes follow the envelopes).
